body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> LG showcased its touchscreen navigation phone ‘Venus’ during CES 2008.
The Venus is the brightest star yet in the LG handset lineup because it combines the best of all mobile worlds.

Available in black and pink, this sophisticated and stunning slider-style phone features dual screens with interactive touch navigation, a music player, a 2.0 megapixel camera/camcorder, and a microSD memory port for extra storage. And of course it is Bluetooth-capable and V CAST-ready, providing stellar performance while on the go.
